description: This file defines the class AutoTOCAdder, which adds a Table of Contents placeholder to Markdown documents during parsing if the automatic TOC feature is enabled and not already present.

classes.name: AutoTOCAdder
classes.description: A class that adds an automatic Table of Contents placeholder to Markdown documents based on configuration settings.

methods.name: onDocumentParsed
methods.description: Responds to the DocumentParsedEvent and adds a TOC placeholder if auto-TOC is enabled and not already present.

methods.name: isAutoTOC
methods.description: Checks the configuration to determine if automatic Table of Contents generation is enabled.

methods.name: hasTOCPlaceholder
methods.description: Inspects the document nodes to see if a TOC placeholder already exists.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration object for the class.
